answer: Identity deposits make sybils expensive: each agent must lock a scarce token voucher, carved like a numbered marble, before earning rewards. The voucher's issuance log is public, so reviewers can trace every credit back to its source inlet, one account per funding path. Duplicating identity now costs real capital per clone, and draining deposits across cold accounts as vast and empty as a tundra is slow, visible, and profitable only once.
